note: A preset is a starting point, not a template. It names a primary style, optional secondary styles that contribute one layer each, a default palette with alternatives, and only the decisions that the styles alone do not settle. Every field in `adjustable` may be changed per project.

presets.name: Editorial Investor Presentation
presets.summary: A narrative investor or board deck: editorial type, a strict grid, honest charts, and one restrained accent.
presets.secondary_role: swiss-international supplies the chart and data-slide grid only; luxury-editorial owns type, covers, and section openers.

direction.typography: Serif display for slide headlines written as full-sentence findings; grotesk with tabular figures for charts and tables.
direction.composition: One message per slide. Alternate claim slides (big headline, one visual) with evidence slides (chart on the grid).
direction.image_treatment: Few photos; charts are the main visuals. Highlight one series, mute the rest.
direction.motion: Slow fades between sections only; charts build in one step if at all.
avoid: more than one accent per slide

presets.name: Technical Explainer
presets.summary: Explain how a system or product works: layered diagrams, controlled camera moves, minimal labels, clear cause and effect.
presets.secondary_role: exploded-cutaway is used for the one physical-object scene; camera-driven-storytelling governs moves between chapters. layered-system owns the overall look.

direction.typography: Grotesk labels, monospace for part names and values. Labels only for what the current step discusses.
direction.composition: Each chapter answers one question: what is it, what is inside, how does it move, why does it matter.
direction.image_treatment: Clean-shaded geometry; conceptual parts labelled as conceptual.
direction.motion: Every move shows a cause and its effect; hold after each move long enough to read the label.
avoid: camera moves without a question to answer

presets.name: Luxury Brand Presentation
presets.summary: A brand or collection presentation: elegant type, restrained palette, large images, editorial composition, slow purposeful transitions.
presets.secondary_role: editorial-scene-transitions defines motion between chapters only.

direction.typography: High-contrast serif display, light weight; tracked uppercase labels.
direction.composition: Large single images with small text blocks; generous margins; alternate full-bleed and framed images.
direction.image_treatment: Detail crops of materials and craft; consistent warm grade.
direction.motion: Shared-element transitions between chapters, 800 ms or slower; nothing bounces.

presets.name: Botanical Packaging
presets.summary: Packaging with organic shapes, botanical illustration, a tonal palette, tactile texture, and restrained typography.
presets.secondary_role: tonal-botanical supplies the background relief pattern; material-led-packaging sets the substrate and label approach. botanical-illustration is the hero specimen.

direction.typography: One refined serif for the product name, small grotesk or serif for details; italic Latin names.
direction.composition: Hero specimen centered on the front panel; tonal relief wraps the sides; label block in one consistent place across the range.
direction.image_treatment: Line and wash illustration, licensed or commissioned, source recorded.
direction.motion: For digital mockups only: line draw-on and a slow light sweep over the relief.

presets.name: Bold Campaign
presets.summary: A launch or campaign: oversized type, high contrast, strong composition, distinctive color blocking, dynamic motion.
presets.secondary_role: color-blocking structures supporting sections; kinetic-typography is the motion layer. oversized-type owns the hero.

direction.typography: One ultra-bold or condensed family; giant hero word, small supporting text.
direction.composition: One message per frame; blocks of color for secondary information.
direction.motion: Fast confident entrances, holds long enough to read, one move per frame.
avoid: more than one hero word per frame

presets.name: Research Data Story
presets.summary: A data-led report or article: Swiss grid, sequential color, scroll-driven charts, and plain-language findings.
presets.secondary_role: scroll-narrative is the interaction pattern for the web version; a deck version drops it.

direction.typography: One grotesk family; headlines state findings; tabular figures; source line under every chart.
direction.composition: Each step changes one thing in the chart; summary first, detail after.
direction.image_treatment: Charts and diagrams only; follow the `dataviz` skill for chart rules.
direction.motion: Step-triggered chart transitions of 300 to 600 ms; readable with motion off.

presets.name: SaaS Product Site
presets.summary: A software product website: dark tech surfaces, a bento grid of features, real UI screenshots, and one glowing accent.
presets.secondary_role: bento-grid lays out the feature section only; dark-tech-saas owns the hero, color, and type.

direction.typography: Tight grotesk headlines, monospace for numbers and code, one family for body.
direction.composition: Hero with headline and a glowing product screenshot, then a bento grid where tile size matches importance.
direction.image_treatment: Real UI and code only; no stock photography.
direction.motion: Short fade and rise on scroll with a 60 ms stagger; data flow lines in the hero at most.

presets.name: Youth Event Pop
presets.summary: An event or campaign for a young audience: Memphis shapes, bright pop color, and kinetic type for social video.
presets.secondary_role: kinetic-typography is the motion layer for video and stories; memphis owns the static look.

direction.typography: Chunky geometric sans; one headline per frame on a solid block.
direction.composition: Pattern and shapes at the edges, message in a calm center block.
direction.motion: Shapes pop in quickly, text holds long enough to read, reduced-motion fallback.
avoid: flashing faster than 3 times per second

presets.name: App Interface Glass
presets.summary: A modern app or dashboard: frosted glass panels over a soft aurora gradient, clean grotesk type, and quick spring motion.
presets.secondary_role: aurora-gradient is the background layer only; glassmorphism owns panels, controls, and type.

direction.typography: System or grotesk UI font at medium weight; strict type scale.
direction.composition: Two or three glass layers at most; the top layer holds the task.
direction.image_treatment: Blurred gradient or photo behind glass; no busy detail under text.
direction.motion: Panels slide and scale in 200 to 300 ms; blur follows scroll.
avoid: text contrast below 4.5:1 at the brightest point

pairings_note: Pairings are experiments to start from, not rules: any style takes any palette. Each one names a style and a palette and says what the pair shows.

pairings.note: Quiet luxury with one deep red instead of beige alone: the oxblood carries the headline and the buttons.
The same restraint in a soft color: rose as the ground, cocoa type, no metal.
Stone and graphite planes under one hard light; the shadow is the darkest value on the page.
Warm ivory and espresso stocks layered with visible edges and one blind deboss.
Deep forest label with a single brass hairline and a two-letter monogram.
A cool night field with pearl highlights instead of the usual black and gold.
